about: Register the sale of land or a property between a seller and a buyer in Dubai.
note: Requirements read from the official Dubai Land Department service page on the checked date. The sign-in forms do not publish their field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Register a property sale. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Emirates ID of seller and buyer, or a valid passport for non-resident foreigners
E-NOC from the developer in freehold areas, via the Dubai REST app
fees: 2% of the sale value from the seller and 2% from the buyer
AED 250 for the title deed certificate
AED 10 knowledge fee and AED 10 innovation fee
AED 4,000 plus VAT service partner fee if the value is AED 500,000 or more, otherwise AED 2,000 plus VAT
channels: a Real Estate Registration Trustee Centre
